RelayApprovalOptions

Approvals asked through the agent, for tabs that take them from the agent (an unattended tab, or one connected with approvals: "agent" or "both").

Properties

identify?
optional identify?: (request) => MaybePromise<RelayPrincipal | null>;

Who opened an approval page: the principal and tenant of the person's own session on this request (a cookie your identity provider set for the relay's domain, for instance), or null. The page accepts a decision only from the principal and tenant the approval is for. Without it the relay serves no approval page outside development, and never offers URL mode. In development (devPairing), the default trusts any loopback caller.

Parameters
request

Request

Returns

MaybePromise<RelayPrincipal | null>

linkTtlMs?
optional linkTtlMs?: number;

How long an approval link works, in ms. Default 300000 (five minutes).

pageUrl?
optional pageUrl?: string;

The public origin approval pages are linked under. Default baseUrl (or the address listen bound). Must be https, or http on a loopback host.

sensitive?
optional sensitive?: (row, request) => boolean;

Which acts are decided on the approval page (URL mode) rather than in a form in the client: default, an act on a sensitive entry. A form shows its text to the MCP client; a page the relay serves does not.

Parameters
row

ObservedEntry

request

ActRequest

Returns

boolean

RelayOptions

Properties

actTimeoutMs?
optional actTimeoutMs?: number;

How long to wait for a tab to answer an act, in ms. Default 30000.

agentAuth?
optional agentAuth?: RelayAgentAuth;

How agents authenticate over HTTP. Without it (and without devPairing) /mcp is not served.

application?
optional application?: object;

Trusted provider-registry identity for this application. A Surface that reports another id is refused. Profiles are optional for compatibility with older application packages.

id
id: string;
name?
optional name?: string;

approvals?
optional approvals?: RelayApprovalOptions;

Approvals asked through the agent's MCP client (elicitation) and the relay's approval page.

audience?
optional audience?: string;

The aud relay tokens must carry. Default axe-relay.

authenticateTab?
optional authenticateTab?: (token, context) => MaybePromise<RelayPrincipal & object | null>;

Authenticate a tab yourself instead of with a relay token signed by secret: return the principal and tenant the token speaks for, or null to refuse. Never accept a session cookie here; the page sends only what your backend minted for this purpose.

Parameters
token

string

context

TabAuthContext

Returns

MaybePromise<RelayPrincipal & object | null>

baseUrl?
optional baseUrl?: string;

The relay's public URL, as the AXE manifest names it. Default http://localhost.

content?
optional content?: boolean;

Serve surface_read and surface_wait (the page's content, and waiting for slow work) when domains does not name them. They answer from a tab running an auto surface and are unavailable, with the reason, in any other. Default true.

deferredAgentAuth?
optional deferredAgentAuth?: RelayDeferredAgentAuth;

Authenticate after first use instead of at MCP initialization. The anonymous transport session is isolated by its random MCP session id; relay_tabs offers the contextual login URL, and subsequent calls use the identity identify established for that same session.

description?
optional description?: string;

devAgentKey?
optional devAgentKey?: string;

The bearer key /mcp accepts in development. Default: random per process (printed by the CLI).

devPairing?
optional devPairing?: boolean;

Local development only: agents pair with a tab by typing the code its indicator shows, and the relay serves development tokens at POST /dev/token. Refused unless the relay listens on loopback; every request must come from loopback with a loopback Host.

devPrincipal?
optional devPrincipal?: RelayPrincipal;

The principal development tokens name. Default { principal: "dev", tenant: "dev" }.

domains?
optional domains?: DomainSpec[];

The parameterized actions for every tab. Default: domainActions' own set (set-field, run-control, load-more). autoDomains() from @axe/surface/auto fits here.

handoff?
optional handoff?: RelayHandoffOptions;

Zero-backend tab connection. When an authenticated agent has no tab, relay_tabs hands the person a short-lived URL. That page opens appUrl; the installed browser package exchanges the one-time handoff for a tab credential and connects without a pairing code.

name?
optional name?: string;

Name and description of the MCP server.

namespace?
optional namespace?: string;

Namespace of the tab's tools: surface gives surface_observe, surface_set-field, ...

onEvent?
optional onEvent?: (event) => void;

The relay's audit stream.

event

RelayEvent

Every frame in and out of a tab connection, for debugging and tests.

Parameters
direction

"in" | "out"

tabId

string | null

data

string

Returns

void

origins?
optional origins?: string[] | ((origin) => boolean);

The page origins allowed to connect a tab. Each is an exact origin (https://app.example.com), a subdomain pattern (https://*.example.com, which does not match the apex), or any port (http://localhost:*); or pass a function. Required unless devPairing is on, where the default is any port on http://localhost, http://127.0.0.1, and http://[::1].

reconnectGraceMs?
optional reconnectGraceMs?: number;

How long an act waits for a reconnecting tab (a reload), in ms. Default 10000.

secret?
optional secret?: string;

The HMAC secret relay tokens are signed with (mintRelayToken), at least 32 characters. Required unless authenticateTab is given or devPairing is on (which uses a random per-process secret for its development tokens).

syncTimeoutMs?
optional syncTimeoutMs?: number;

How long to wait for a fresh snapshot before serving the last one, in ms. Default 5000.

tabRetentionMs?
optional tabRetentionMs?: number;

How long a disconnected or stopped tab stays listed, in ms. Default 600000.

tenants?
optional tenants?: string[];

Tenants this relay serves; a tab or an agent of any other tenant is refused. Default: any.
